name: corpus.source
description: Advisory screen for a candidate doctrine-corpus source (YouTube channel, newsletter or site) against a named SEED. The state carries SEED (who we are extending and why) and CANDIDATE (name, size, recent titles). Decides whether the candidate is a real peer worth a full-transcript scrape. Counting, sizes, dedupe and final ordering stay in code; only the judgment is asked here.

same_domain.instructions: The CANDIDATE mainly teaches the same subject as the SEED to the same kind of audience. For a business-strategy seed that means strategy, positioning, differentiation, category, competitive advantage, pricing, go-to-market or marketing effectiveness, taught to business owners, founders or leaders.

practitioner_voice.instructions: The CANDIDATE is one named practitioner or strategist arguing in their own voice. It is not a news show, a pure interview feed, a textbook-summary channel or an AI-voiced compilation.

argues_not_lists.instructions: The CANDIDATE's titles signal reasoned or contrarian argument (why a common belief is wrong, what actually drives results) rather than listicles, hacks, hype or motivation.

seed_similarity.instructions: How close is the CANDIDATE to the SEED in subject, audience and argumentative style
criteria: Adjacent business topic with a different audience or purpose
Same broad subject but a very different format (news, interviews, textbook summaries)
Same subject and audience, partly similar style
Close peer: same subject, audience and argumentative style

rules.reason: candidate is not clearly in the seed's subject and audience
candidate is not one practitioner arguing in their own voice
candidate reads as listicles or hype, not argument
candidate is not a close peer of the seed
similarity answer distribution is not concentrated

notes.bar: Nouls pass only above 0.9 (0.90 fails `noul <= 0.90`). seed_similarity deliberately passes at a mean above 3.50 (level 4, close peer) rather than the default 4.50: level 5 means a near-duplicate of the seed, which adds no new doctrine to a corpus.
notes.provenance: Added 2026-09-26 by Jake (Aside session FZ5G1NeEd86P2RZw) to select peer channels for the business-strategy corpus seeded by Alex M H Smith. Advisory until calibrated; the ordering of candidates is computed in code from these typed answers.
notes.planted_failure: Must ESCALATE a channel that is off-subject (e.g. a news or tax channel) and must not ESCALATE the seed itself on same_domain; see the corpus build log for the red/green pair.
